parsed.reason: The text supports the claim that when manually modifying or moving data files is unavoidable, it is sufficient to save the final file without recording specific modifications or purposes. The evidence includes Rule 1 and Rule 2 which emphasize avoiding manual operations and specifying workflows for reusability.

evidence.quote: As a minimum, you should at least record sufficient details on programs, parameters, and manual procedures to allow yourself, in a year or so, to approximately reproduce the results.
Whenever possible, rely on the execution of programs instead of manual procedures to modify data. Such manual procedures are not only inefficient and error-prone...
